lines.text: If you run a few coding agents at once, you know this: flipping between terminals to see which one finished, and which one is waiting for you to type y.
zh: 同时跑过几个编码 agent 的人，应该都干过这种事：
在几个终端之间来回切，看哪个跑完了，哪个在等你按 y。

lines.text: dugong puts each agent's work in one task list, and every row updates itself.
zh: dugong 把每个 agent 的活放进一张任务清单，每一行的状态都会自己更新。

lines.text: You write the task, pick a folder and an agent, and press Start.
zh: 写好任务，选目录、选 agent，点开始。

lines.text: When the agent finishes a turn, the task moves to Review and turns red.
zh: agent 跑完一轮，任务就跳到 Review，变成红色。

lines.text: Red means it needs you. Everything else can wait.
zh: 红色表示需要你处理。
其余的可以先不管。

lines.text: On the right is the assistant. Everyone gets one, and it can see the task you have open.
zh: 右边是助手。
每个人都有一个，它能看到你打开的任务。

lines.text: It reads the task and its own notes. Here it remembers a rule from earlier: check for live sessions before restarting the runner. And it spots that the tests miss the handoff path.
zh: 它会看任务记录，也会翻自己记下的东西。
这里它想起之前记下的一条规矩：
重启 runner 之前，先看有没有活跃的会话。
它还发现，测试漏了交接这条路径。

lines.text: Tell it to add the test, and that runner changes always need one. It saves the rule, then messages the task. Anything that touches another task asks you first.
zh: 让它补测试，再告诉它以后改 runner 都要补。
它把这条规矩存下来，再去给那个任务发消息。
凡是要动别的任务，都会先问你。

lines.text: Everything it remembers is listed here. You can edit any note, or undo its changes.
zh: 它记住的东西都列在这里。
每一条都能改，它改过的也能撤销。

lines.text: When it isn't sure, it doesn't stop and wait. It picks an option, writes down why and how to undo it, and you look when you have time.
zh: 它拿不准的时候，不会停下来等你。
它先选一个，写下为什么、选错了怎么退回去，你有空再看。

lines.text: So you can close the laptop.
zh: 所以你可以把电脑合上。

lines.text: When an agent needs permission, your phone gets a notification. Tap Allow, and it keeps going.
zh: agent 需要你批准时，手机会收到通知。
点 Allow，它就接着跑。

lines.text: The phone has the same task list, and the same assistant.
zh: 手机上是同一张任务清单，同一个助手。

lines.text: Tasks can run on a schedule.
zh: 任务还能定时跑。

lines.text: And a conversation you already started in the terminal can be picked up as a task.
zh: 你在终端里已经开始的对话，也能接过来变成一个任务。

lines.text: dugong is open source, and runs on your own machine. It works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and seven more agents.
zh: dugong 是开源的，跑在你自己的机器上。
支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等十种 agent。
